cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Naming the two phases of TCP congestion control
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Must correctly identify both Slow Start and Congestion Avoidance phases.
acceptable_variants: Slow start phase and congestion avoidance phase
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.5 marks if only one phase is named.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 1) Names both phases: Slow Start and Congestion Avoidance. (1 mark)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Slow start (cwnd less than ss_thresh): ... Congestion Avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh):

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Explain that cwnd grows fast (exponentially/doubling per RTT) while cwnd < ss_thresh.
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 1 mark if the growth is described as 'fast' but lacks the specific mechanism (exponential/doubling).
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 2) Slow Start behaviour: while cwnd < ss_thresh, cwnd grows fast (typically +1 per ACK → exponential / doubles each RTT) until ss_thresh (or loss). (1.5 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: In the slow start phase, cwnd is incremented by one every time a segment is acknowledged. This results in an exponential growth as cwnd is essentially doubled after each Round Trip Time (RTT).

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Explain that cwnd grows slowly (linearly) when cwnd >= ss_thresh.
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.5 marks if the growth is described as 'slow' but lacks the specific mechanism (linear).
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 3) Congestion Avoidance behaviour: when cwnd >= ss_thresh, cwnd grows more slowly (typically linear, e.g. +1 per RTT / after window ACKed). (1.5 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: In the congestion avoidance phase, cwnd is incremented more slowly. There are different incrementation strategies, but they usually grow linearly

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Explain that upon loss, ss_thresh is halved (cwnd/2) and cwnd is reset (to 1).
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.5 marks if only one of the two actions (halving ss_thresh or resetting cwnd) is mentioned.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 4) Loss / congestion reaction (as in the reference): ss_thresh becomes cwnd/2 (or similar halving) and cwnd is reset (typically to 1) — may be stated for either phase. (1 mark)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: After a packet is lost / congestion the following adaption is made in both phases: ss_thresh = cwnd / 2. Then cwnd is reset to 1.
